competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times using its gigantic body to put the enemies that are under the [Freezing Air] effect under the freezing effect.

Attacks the enemies in the frontline 2 times with a sharp thorn. The damage increases substantially as the target's Defense decreases. This attack will target the backline if there are no enemies left in the frontline.
Grants [Freezing Air] Effect on all enemies with an ice roar. The [Freezing Air] Effect becomes stronger every time the Freezing Roar is used.
Removes all beneficial effects on all enemies and attacks them 6 times with ice breath to inflict damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.
